total No bound exists #

Upper bounds — holds for every total

  • \(\mathrm{C}^1(f) \le \mathrm{s}^0(f)\,\mathrm{bs}^1(f)\)
    Nisan91 BdW02
    The mirror image of the $\mathrm{C}^0$ bound. This is the form actually used in $\mathrm{D} \le \mathrm{C}^0\mathrm{C}^1$-style arguments.

Lower bounds / separations — there is a family achieving this

  • \(\mathrm{bs}^1(f) \le \mathrm{C}^1(f)\)
  • \(\mathrm{C}^1(\neg g_n) = \Theta(n),\quad \mathrm{bs}^1(\neg g_n) = O(1)\)
    GSS16
    Negating the output of \(g_n\) swaps the two sides, so the $\mathrm{C}^0$-vs-$\mathrm{bs}^0$ impossibility transfers verbatim. Not recorded as a separate function entry: $\neg g_n$ has the same table as $g_n$ with every superscript flipped.

The dual of the \(\mathrm{C}^0(f)\) vs \(\mathrm{bs}^0(f)\) record, and it fails for the same reason: the product bound spends its whole budget on the other side, here $\mathrm{s}^0$.

see also: \(\mathrm{C}^1(f)\), \(\mathrm{bs}^1(f)\), \(\mathrm{s}^0(f)\), \(\mathrm{C}^0(f)\), \(\mathrm{bs}^0(f)\), \(g_n\) data/relations/10-new-measures.yaml
